planName: Recipe Ingredient Sheet — Live Updates (Edit Mode)

architecturalDecisions.title: Edit-mode only scope
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live updates apply only to the edit mode of AddIngredientProvider (present with an existing ingredient). Add mode retains its explicit 'Add Ingredient' footer button, success toast, and sheet-stays-open continuous-entry UX.

architecturalDecisions.title: New code under edit-ingredient subfolder
architecturalDecisions.decision: All new modules (diff helper, live-sync hook, null-rendering live-sync consumer) live under features/recipes/components/edit-ingredient/.

architecturalDecisions.title: Reuse existing writer
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live writes invoke the existing updateRecipeIngredient function directly. No updateRecipeIngredientOnly split is introduced because recipe_ingredients do not link to saved_items.

architecturalDecisions.title: Single live-write pathway
architecturalDecisions.decision: There is no deferred close-time cross-entity sync. The only close-time work is flushing the pending text debounce.

architecturalDecisions.title: Debounce contract
architecturalDecisions.decision: Text fields (name, notes) use a 300ms trailing debounce via useDebounceCallback from usehooks-ts. Non-text fields (category, quantity, unit, storeId) fire immediate live writes. The debounce is flushed on sheet close and cancelled on autocomplete pick.

architecturalDecisions.title: Live-write validity gate
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live writes are gated by the full isValid rule from useItemSheet: non-empty trimmed name AND truthy quantity AND truthy unit. When the form is ever not-valid, live writes are skipped until it is valid again.

architecturalDecisions.title: Sheet lifecycle mapping
architecturalDecisions.decision: In edit mode, onStartClose flushes pending debounce and then calls reset(). onDismiss resets form state (if not already reset) and clears the snapshot ref. Add mode's lifecycle is unchanged.

architecturalDecisions.title: Autocomplete pick semantics
architecturalDecisions.decision: A pick cancels pending debounce, immediately updateRecipeIngredient with the picked fields (preserving form quantity), and rebases the snapshot to the picked values. No saved_items relink is performed.

architecturalDecisions.title: Unified provider with isEditing branch
architecturalDecisions.decision: AddIngredientProvider stays unified. Edit-specific wiring (live-sync child, footer hiding, onSubmit no-op, onPickMatch, onStartClose flush, onDismiss cleanup) is conditionally applied based on isEditing. No separate EditIngredientProvider is introduced.

architecturalDecisions.title: Error handling
architecturalDecisions.decision: Live writes rely on Instant's optimistic UI and offline queue. No new catch-and-toast error surface is introduced.

tickets.title: Diff helper for ingredient snapshot
tickets.summary: Add a pure diff helper for recipe ingredients under the new edit-ingredient subfolder that returns the subset of fields that changed between a captured snapshot and current form values, using trim-normalized comparison for string fields and numeric equality for quantity.
acceptanceCriteria: Exports an IngredientSnapshot type containing name, optional category, optional notes, quantity, unit, and optional storeId
Exports diffIngredientSnapshot({ snapshot, current }) returning Partial<IngredientSnapshot> with only the fields that differ
String field comparison trims both sides; empty string and undefined are treated as equal for optional fields
Quantity is compared as numeric equality
No React, hook, or Instant imports in the module
outOfScope: Unit tests for the helper (PRD defers tests; grocery's diffItemSnapshot tests are the model if added later)

tickets.title: useLiveIngredientSync hook
tickets.summary: Add the live-sync hook under the new edit-ingredient subfolder. It reads form state from useItemSheet, owns a snapshot ref and current-store-id baseline, debounces text-field writes at 300ms trailing, fires immediate writes for category/quantity/unit/storeId, gates all writes on isValid, commits via updateRecipeIngredient, and exposes an imperative handle via a MutableRefObject prop.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts { selectedIngredientId, currentStoreId, handleRef } props
Reads itemInputValue, notesInputValue, category, quantity, unit, storeId, and isValid from useItemSheet
Owns a snapshot ref and a current-store-id ref; a stable stateRef mirrors latest props and form state so callbacks do not close over stale values
Uses useDebounceCallback (usehooks-ts) with 300ms delay, trailing edge
One effect reacts to [itemInputValue, notesInputValue, debouncedCommit] by calling debouncedCommit()
A second effect reacts to [category, quantity, unit, storeId] by calling the commit function immediately
commit is a no-op when there is no snapshot, no selectedIngredientId, or isValid is false
commit diffs snapshot vs current and returns when the diff is empty
commit invokes updateRecipeIngredient with the full current payload and currentStoreId from the hook's ref baseline
After a successful write, snapshot is updated to current and currentStoreIdRef is updated when storeId was in the diff

handleRef exposes { captureSnapshot(ingredient), flush(), clearSnapshot() } where captureSnapshot seeds snapshot and currentStoreIdRef, flush calls debouncedCommit.flush(), and clearSnapshot nulls snapshot and calls debouncedCommit.cancel()
handleRef also exposes an onPickMatch stub that is safe to call but is a no-op in this ticket (wired fully in P2)

tickets.title: EditIngredientLiveSync null-renderer
tickets.summary: Add a thin null-rendering consumer under the edit-ingredient subfolder that runs useLiveIngredientSync inside ItemSheetProvider and publishes its imperative handle via the liveSyncRef it receives as a prop.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts { selectedIngredientId, currentStoreId, liveSyncRef } props
Renders null
Calls useLiveIngredientSync with handleRef={liveSyncRef}
Exports the LiveIngredientSyncHandle type for consumers

tickets.title: Wire live-sync into AddIngredientProvider and remove edit-mode footer affordances
tickets.summary: Integrate EditIngredientLiveSync into AddIngredientProvider so edit-mode persistence is live. The footer 'Update Ingredient' button and success toast are removed from the edit branch; add mode is untouched. Sheet close hooks flush the debounce and clear the snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Provider owns a liveSyncRef: MutableRefObject<LiveIngredientSyncHandle | null>
When isEditing is true, <EditIngredientLiveSync /> is rendered inside ItemSheetProvider with selectedIngredientId, currentStoreId, and liveSyncRef
Footer 'Update Ingredient' button is not rendered when isEditing is true; 'Add Ingredient' button is preserved when isEditing is false
ItemSheetProvider.onSubmit is a no-op in edit mode; the success toast and manual sheetRef.current?.dismiss() for the edit branch are removed
Add mode onSubmit keeps its existing behavior (addRecipeIngredient + toast + reset)
present(ingredient) calls liveSyncRef.current?.captureSnapshot(ingredient) after setFromItemRef.current?.(...) and before sheetRef.current?.present()
BottomSheet onStartClose in edit mode calls liveSyncRef.current?.flush() before calling reset()
BottomSheet onDismiss is added and, in edit mode, calls reset() and liveSyncRef.current?.clearSnapshot()
Add-mode onStartClose/onDismiss behavior is equivalent to today (reset + clear editing state)
No regression in clearing editingIngredient or currentStoreId on close
Editing an ingredient, changing name/notes, dismissing the sheet, and reopening shows the changes persisted
Editing an ingredient, changing category/quantity/unit/store, and dismissing shows the changes persisted without any footer button tap
No success toast is shown in the edit flow
testPlan: Manual: open a recipe I own, tap an ingredient, edit name, notes, quantity, unit, category, and store; swipe-dismiss; reopen to confirm all changes persisted
Manual: open an ingredient, clear the name to empty, pause past the debounce, and confirm no write fires (name is unchanged on reopen); restore the name and confirm normal persistence resumes
Manual: confirm 'Add Ingredient' flow still works end-to-end: footer button present, toast appears, sheet stays open, form resets

phases.title: Autocomplete pick rebase in edit mode
userStories: Story 11: pick commits immediately so subsequent edits diff against picked values
Story 12: pick takes precedence over pending debounce

tickets.title: Implement onPickMatch in useLiveIngredientSync
tickets.summary: Replace the P1 onPickMatch stub with the real implementation: cancel any pending debounce, commit picked fields via updateRecipeIngredient (preserving form quantity), and rebase the snapshot ref (and currentStoreIdRef where applicable) to the picked values.
acceptanceCriteria: handleRef.onPickMatch(match) calls debouncedCommit.cancel() before any write
Commits updateRecipeIngredient with the picked fields (name, category, notes, storeId, and unit if present on the match) while preserving the current form quantity
Passes the current ingredient's currentStoreIdRef so the store link reconciles correctly when the pick's storeId differs from the current baseline
Rebases snapshot to the post-pick values so subsequent diffs measure user edits after the pick
Updates currentStoreIdRef to the picked storeId when present
Guarded by the same isValid/selectedIngredientId/snapshot preconditions as commit
Does not attempt any saved_items relink

tickets.title: Wire onPickMatch prop in edit mode
tickets.summary: Pass onPickMatch to ItemSheetProvider only when the sheet is in edit mode, routing calls through the liveSyncRef imperative handle so autocomplete picks are handled by the hook.
acceptanceCriteria: ItemSheetProvider receives onPickMatch={(match) => liveSyncRef.current?.onPickMatch(match)} when isEditing is true
ItemSheetProvider does not receive onPickMatch in add mode (add flow remains untouched)
While editing: typing a few characters to surface autocomplete, then picking a match, commits the picked fields immediately without waiting for debounce
While editing: picking a match while a text debounce is pending does not produce a stale keystroke write after the pick
After a pick, further edits diff against the picked values (verifiable by changing one picked field and observing only that field gets written)
testPlan: Manual: edit an existing ingredient, type a partial name to surface autocomplete, and pick a suggestion — verify fields update and reopen shows the picked values
Manual: begin a rapid keystroke sequence that leaves debounce pending, pick a match — confirm the post-pick ingredient reflects the pick, not the stale keystrokes
outOfScope: Changing autocomplete matching or sort logic
